title: Soft Bubble Town (dialed back)
question: Pastel Bubble Town, but less childish/cute — more minimal, simple, still round and soft. Which balance?

options.label: Quiet Bubbles
options.lineage: Pastel Bubble Town → minimal soft geometry
options.thesis: Places are quiet pastel circles on a warm cream field; thin soft curves for routes; almost no decoration — soft and round without chibi faces.
materials: no faces / no stickers / no sparkles
options.viewport: Desktop: warm cream canvas. Large soft circles (places) in muted mint/rose/sand — labels in small quiet sans inside or beside. Thin curved mint/rose lines connect a few pairs. Top: Drift wordmark in simple rounded sans + CMU CREW. One soft pill Log trip (muted coral). Discovery: a new circle gently appears + short soft toast. Chrome minimal; map reads in under a second.
options.risk: Can feel empty if circles lack just enough label hierarchy.

raised.raise: Keep the bubble-town topology (round places, soft town feel) but strip characters, stickers, and candy chrome.

options.label: Two-Tone Soft Map
options.lineage: even more minimal — one accent only
options.thesis: Cream ground, charcoal type, one soft mint accent for live routes and the primary button — bubbles in warm gray.
options.viewport: Very quiet: gray soft bubbles, mint only on active edges + Log trip pill; Drift wordmark small; almost no sidebar clutter.

options.label: Rounded Soft Grid
options.lineage: bubble town as a soft rounded-card layout
options.thesis: Same softness, slightly more structure: rounded panels and circle nodes aligned on a loose soft grid for easier scanning.
options.viewport: Map area with soft bubble nodes; slim rounded legend; Log trip pill; discovery as a soft rounded banner — still no cute characters.
options.case: Easier to use / clearer hierarchy; a bit less “town illustration.”
options.risk: Can read closer to normal product UI.

options.label: Orb Cluster
options.lineage: bubble town with fewer, larger orbs
options.thesis: Only a handful of large soft orbs (neighborhoods) with tiny dots inside for places — ultra simple silhouette.
options.viewport: 3–5 big soft neighborhood orbs; sparse labels; mint connectors between orbs; Log trip pill; unlock soft-fills one orb slightly stronger.
options.case: Simplest read at a glance; less detail for dense graphs.

canonCard.label: Soft product standard
canonCard.thesis: Standard soft map UI with slightly rounder nodes — usable default if bubbles feel too abstract.
canonCard.viewport: Clean map + minimal sidebar + Log trip.
